description: This file defines the HelpService class in the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It manages help-related configurations and processor instances, providing methods to retrieve URLs and validate the help URL.

classes.name: HelpService
classes.description: Manages help configuration and processing for the OrangeHRM Help plugin, providing URL retrieval and validation functionalities.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the HelpConfigService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHelpProcessor
methods.description: Returns the HelpProcessor instance, initializing it based on configuration if not already set.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Delegates to HelpProcessor to get a redirect URL for a given help label.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the default help redirect URL from HelpProcessor.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Validates the base help URL from configuration.
